prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. Three adult volunteers aged 28 to 42 have restored an ordinary courtyard bench. A red-haired woman peels masking tape from its edge while a clean-shaven bald man and a dark-curly-haired woman exchange a relaxed high-five beside her. Show practical work clothes, a closed paint tin and believable dry paint in afternoon daylight, with all important hands and the full bench interaction centred. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.
Native image aspect ratio exactly 16:9. Medium-wide environmental framing with all three people and their important actions as one compact group in the middle two-thirds of image width. Leave ordinary courtyard or garden context at both outer edges so that the full heads and key hand gestures remain intact after a central 4:3 crop.
review: Wide courtyard restoration scene shows three adults around one coherent slatted bench with metal supports. One woman peels real masking tape with separate fingers while the other two complete a plausible palm-to-palm high-five. Faces, limbs, bench and continuous ground are natural, and no words/logos are visible. Rendered central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were viewed: all three heads, tape-removal hands, high-five hands and the bench action remain intact.
